title: BioIVT: diagnosis questions become a type-ahead SNOMED CT lookup
description: Turns eight free-text questions about conditions (donor diagnosis; specimen diagnosis on Follow-up, Outcome and Oncology; confirmed diagnosis; medication indication; cause of death; reason for hospitalisation) into a type-ahead lookup over real SNOMED CT concept ids. DEMONSTRATION list: real codes, partial, not clinically reviewed; licences to be confirmed before real use.
rationale: Option C: diagnoses coded to SNOMED CT at the point of entry.
source: BioIVT Option C build for the client demonstration; approved by Dan

history.note: Phase 2 build for the client demonstration.
Added medication indication (CM), cause of death (DD) and reason for hospitalisation (MH) to the SNOMED CT lookup and its Other rows.
